lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately five visible vertical columns posterior to the gill slits, with 3 to 5 nodes per column forming a regular geometric grid.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher luminance intersect with horizontal alignments of spots, creating a visible lattice pattern where the spots serve as anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the lateral flank, characterized by a sharp vertical intensity gradient with highlights on the superior edge and shadows on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Several remoras are attached to the posterior margin of the left pectoral fin and the adjacent ventral-lateral flank region.
